incident: Initial individualised source-directory scan assumed classic ZIP offsets; 10-SW-22C uses ZIP64. The uint32 sentinel offset requested an unnecessary archive range before the format check failed.
retry: One old-code retry was cancelled while awaiting response headers; no body was read. A separate 65,536-byte diagnostic tail was read.
fix: Parse ZIP64 EOCD offsets before requesting any prefix. Both directory sizes and HTTP Content-Length are capped at 4 MiB before reads. Parse original directory records without rewriting source bytes.
trafficNote: Successful range totals exclude this failed transfer; report the incident separately. No claim that only a couple of MB were transferred in the entire investigation.
